person.name: Elena Marku
person.headline: Front Office Manager | Guest Experience | Hotel Operations

draft.current: Front Office Manager at a 320-room hotel
draft.strength: a calm hand in busy shifts, clean handovers and a team that stays
draft.achievement: In my current role I raised our guest rating from 4.3 to 4.7 in 18 months and cut check-in waiting times at peak hours from 12 to 5 minutes.
draft.why: Seaview Grand stands for personal service at a large scale, which is exactly how I like to lead: close to guests and close to the team.

draft.achievement: In meiner aktuellen Position habe ich unsere Gästebewertung in 18 Monaten von 4,3 auf 4,7 gesteigert und die Wartezeit beim Check-in zu Spitzenzeiten von 12 auf 5 Minuten gesenkt.
draft.why: Das Seaview Grand steht für persönlichen Service in großem Rahmen, und genau so führe ich gern: nah am Gast und nah am Team.

person.headline: Front Office Manager | Përvoja e mysafirit | Operacione hoteli

draft.current: Front Office Manager në një hotel me 320 dhoma
draft.strength: qetësi në turnet e ngarkuara, dorëzime të qarta dhe një ekip që qëndron

draft.why: Seaview Grand përfaqëson shërbim personal në shkallë të madhe, dhe pikërisht kështu më pëlqen të drejtoj: pranë mysafirëve dhe pranë ekipit.
